# Third-party skills bundled with PLUR1BUS

Skills in this folder come from outside the project and ship unchanged (spec D57). Each entry records where the skill came from, its licence and a SHA-256 checksum over the folder. `update --check` compares against that checksum.

| Skill | Source | Licence | Pinned |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frontend-gui-webdesign` | Supplied by the owner, 2026-09-27 | Apache-2.0 (per `SKILL.md` frontmatter) | see `CHECKSUMS` |
